Codex CLI 与多配置目录联动实验版 / Interactive CLI and multiple Codex homes.

- 新增本机交互式 `codex`、`resume`、`fork`；CLI 独立使用无需 VS Code。用户任务开始显示游玩，结束即退出；保留静默、无日志、无自启。
- 配置升级至版本 3，管理界面可分别启停 CLI / 扩展并管理多个目录。所有目录共用一个工具任务后台；来源和记录错误仅隔离对应会话。
- 从 v0.1.1 在原目录修复安装，保留未变更通知的原生信任、账号、快捷方式及图片，等待下一次新任务。新增目录须通过 CLI `/hooks` 或扩展原生审核，随后重启会话。

Download `CodexSteamBridge-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip`, extract and double-click `CodexSteamBridge.exe`. The source ZIP is for review/building. Verify both ZIPs with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Local smoke tests: Windows 10 22H2 x64; CLI 0.163.0 (`--no-daemon`), installed CLI 0.167.0 (default startup), existing VS Code extension 26.1021.22027. Isolated tests cover multiple homes, npm layouts, process ownership, detached execution, UTF-8 hook pipes and transactional changes. Windows 11 desktop and other client versions are not marked verified; see COMPATIBILITY.md for remaining manual acceptance.

Not supported: automated `exec` / `review`, WSL, remote development, containers, ARM64. No model account is needed for CI tests. Public artwork is original.
